notes.title: High CPU & GPU Utilization Fix
notes.content:
Optimization & Performance Improvements


Dynamically adjusting FPS and toggling rendering when switching between foreground and background modes to save CPU & GPU resources.

Optimized variables for rendering at foreground mode with better performance.

CPU & GPU utilization is significantly reduced in background mode, application runs near idle load.
